Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sandstone canyon floor in front of the rose-red Treasury at Petra, a smooth sandy path and standard-height rock-cut doorways, empty of tourists, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as the figure, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, the camera set back far enough that the whole figure is visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on the figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

ONE real adult Nigerian person with the face of a beautiful woman, the face exactly the same tone as the body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, soft pastel-peach hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold barrel-shaped weight, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a copper square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
Physique: the body of a tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. The head stays in correct proportion to the frame; the arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
Body Art: The bare skin is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers the whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of the hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of the feet. The face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
Pose: back fully to camera.
Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto heels, the platform soles rising far higher than the ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining the figure, each painted pattern catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
